earning.payment: floor(floor(net collected VND / 10000) * (tier multiplier + renewal bonus)); integer basis-point arithmetic
earning.historicalCash: Qualifies lifetime tier only. No spendable payment points before the locked launch date.
earning.recognition: PT Kudos grants XP and badges, not spendable Aura points.

correctnessChanges: No floating-point loss of one payment point.
Earning tier is frozen after launch reconciliation; payment rate and hold remain frozen for later refunds or policy changes.
Cash affects tier during the points hold; vesting does not count it again.
Voided or removed payments reverse points and tier credit.
A shared transactional monthly budget prevents concurrent attendance and nutrition rewards from exceeding the cap.
The thirteenth-week sentinel prevents repeated twelve-week rewards.
Vesting selects due enabled source types, so future or disabled rewards do not block welcome bonuses.
Launch backfill cannot run while earning is enabled.

readChanges.homeCard: Compact dashboard: five exact current mission documents, account and policy; skips Kudos, redemptions and Ambassador reads.
readChanges.memberDashboard: Five exact current mission documents, eight newest Kudos plus server aggregate totals, twelve newest redemptions.
readChanges.history: Timestamp/document-ID cursor; at most 31 ledger documents for a 30-row page; no 300-entry ceiling.
readChanges.tabs: Reward catalog, history and referral workspace load on their own tab; retry affects only the failed tab.
readChanges.accountIsolation: Changing account remounts the member workspace so stale responses cannot populate the next account.

remainingScaleWork: Admin overview still scans capped account/redemption/referral/Ambassador collections (up to 3500 documents plus branch student lookup); use aggregate summaries with verified branch scope before claiming full large-scale optimization.
Attendance mission reconciliation paginates student history and nutrition reconciliation paginates approved history for correctness; canonical date projections would reduce event-time reads further.
Legacy web clients retain bounded offset compatibility; the new web client uses cursor pagination.
validation: Firestore emulator: concurrency, monthly caps, refund/void, tier hold, zero policy, staged earning tier, week 12-14, cursor history beyond 300, compact reads and launch/vesting guards
20 Chrome and mobile Safari admin/member UI cases
Typecheck, production build, performance budgets, repository hygiene, secret scan and full Functions checks

deployment.activationGate: Require verified deployed source and healthy 100-percent traffic, complete staged reconciliation, matching wallet/ledger totals and exact welcome recipient count before publishing the immutable activation policy.
